title: Proactive canary eval pipeline and playbook for config/model rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: We keep reacting to customer-facing quality regressions after config or model changes. This ticket creates a focused canary eval pipeline + a triage/runbook so small configuration changes get evaluated against targeted acceptance criteria before wide rollout. Goals: 1) run lightweight, fast canary evals automatically for any config/model change in the staging pipeline; 2) produce a numeric regression delta and human-readable example failures for triage; 3) integrate automatic canary gating into our rollout automation (canary fails -> block rollout or rollback); 4) ship an on-call playbook that reduces time-to-triage for eval-driven incidents.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New canary eval job executes on every config/model PR merge to staging and completes within 10 minutes for typical delta; 2) Thresholds computed automatically and stored in console; alerts fire when primary metric regresses by >3% absolute or >10% relative depending on metric; 3) Each canary run produces a short report (summary + top 5 counterexamples) and posts to the designated Slack channel and a PR comment; 4) Gate hook implemented in rollout automation that prevents >25% rollout when canary fails; 5) Playbook authored and reviewed by SRE/PM/Applied ML and published in Confluence.
implementation_notes: Pipeline components: 1) canary job runner (k8s CronJob + ephemeral pod using existing eval harness), 2) per-config/eval mapping table (yaml) that selects the lightweight eval set for the change type, 3) metric aggregator service that computes deltas and stores results in the eval-db, 4) gating hook in rollout controller. Reuse existing eval harness from ENG-9512 where possible, but implement a pared-down dataset for speed (<=200 samples). Start with core generation and chat evals, add embeddings/rerank later. Add a small wrapper that captures input prefixes and top-3 model outputs for example diffs. Instrument additional timing metrics so we can fine-tune the 10-minute budget.
monitoring_plan:
- Metric dashboard tile: canary_success_rate, avg_regression_delta, canary_latency_seconds.
- Alerts: PAGER when canary_success_rate drops below 95% for 3 consecutive runs OR regression_delta > configured threshold.
- Each run posts a JSON artifact to S3 and a link to the console.
- Integrate with existing eval-alerting playbook (see ENG-8721) for escalation steps.
- On-call runbook includes immediate rollback steps, how to fetch counterexamples, and how to run full eval suite locally.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): enable canary evals for every merge to staging branch for one week; collect metrics and tune thresholds. Phase 2 (canary in prod): wire gating hook to enable small percent rollouts (5%) for non-critical configs. Phase 3 (enforced gate): block automated rollouts above threshold unless a manual override with stakeholder sign-off. Communicate changes to Platform and Applied ML teams and schedule a 30-minute walkthrough session.
